name: relay-oss
description: Relay OSS — Delivery OS: internal agile delivery board for agency client pipelines

scripts.build: npm run build -w @relay/api && npm run build -w @relay/web
scripts.guard: node scripts/guard-no-json-store.mjs && node scripts/guard-sql-portability.mjs && node scripts/gen-pg-migrations.mjs --check && node scripts/check-traceability.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run guard && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:pg && npm run build && npm run smoke:web && npm run backup:verify
scripts.pg:migrate: DATABASE_URL=$(node scripts/pg-dev.mjs url) node apps/api/src/db/cli.ts migrate
scripts.pg:reset: DATABASE_URL=$(node scripts/pg-dev.mjs url) node apps/api/src/db/cli.ts reset
